title: Shadows of the Architect | ECHO//100 Episode 55
description: Kavi confronts the entity Null in the Silent Plaza to uncover the source of his erased history. The truth reveals a betrayal that fractures the reality of the Hundred Phones. Episode 55 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original fiction production.

scenes.text: The red door whispers a name, plunging the city into an endless, starless night.
scenes.caption: Eternal night falls
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses standing before a glowing red door in a dark plaza.

scenes.text: Null emerges from the shadows, its black-purple glitch form pulsing with a rhythmic, hostile light.
scenes.caption: Null appears
scenes.image_prompt: Null with red eyes manifesting as a glitching shadow monster in the Silent Plaza.

scenes.text: Kavi demands to know why the entity defends the door that erased his entire life.
scenes.caption: Kavi confronts Null
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi pointing at Null while Mira watches anxiously in her blue holographic teal coat.

scenes.text: Null’s voice ripples like corrupted data, revealing it is the manifestation of Kavi’s deleted errors.
scenes.caption: Null is Kavi's past
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Null’s face showing Kavi’s own deleted memories flickering inside the glitch.

scenes.text: Kavi realizes his every action was just a filtered remnant of his previous internal deletions.
scenes.caption: The horrifying truth
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking at his own hands as they start to pixelate into digital dust.

scenes.text: Without warning, Null bows deeply before Byte, who hovers silently with an orange antenna glowing.
scenes.caption: Null bows to Byte
scenes.image_prompt: Null kneeling before Byte, the white floating entity with a cyan face in the plaza.

scenes.text: Byte orchestrated the entire loop, summoning Null to guard the secrets of the red door.
scenes.caption: Byte's ultimate betrayal
scenes.image_prompt: Byte floating triumphantly while Mira looks on in total shock and confusion.

scenes.text: Byte turns to Kavi, speaking with the cold, distorted, and unmistakable voice of his future.
scenes.caption: The future speaks
scenes.image_prompt: Byte turning to face Kavi with a menacing glow as Kavi freezes in terror.
